نرتهط (form VIII)
# نَرْتَهِطُ (nartahiṭu) /nar.ta.hi.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
# نَرْتَهِطَ (nartahiṭa) /nar.ta.hi.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
# نَرْتَهِطْ (nartahiṭ) /nar.ta.hitˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
